title: Replace Simiron-hosted flake color images with 17 user-uploaded images

requirements.text: Replace all Simiron CDN-hosted images in the FlakeColorsSection component with the 17 user-uploaded images stored as static assets in frontend/public/assets/generated, mapped to their confirmed color names in this exact order: 1. Tidal Wave (IMG_2262.jpeg), 2. Gravel Blend (IMG_2260.jpeg), 3. Coyote Blend (IMG_2261.jpeg), 4. Wombat Blend (IMG_2259.jpeg), 5. Stargazer Blend (IMG_2263.jpeg), 6. Outback Blend (IMG_2266.jpeg), 7. Orbit Blend (IMG_2267.jpeg), 8. Safari Blend (IMG_2265.jpeg), 9. Creekbed Blend (IMG_2270.jpeg), 10. Nightfall (IMG_2268.jpeg), 11. Glacier Blend (IMG_2272.jpeg), 12. Stonewash Blend (IMG_2273.jpeg), 13. Shoreline Blend (IMG_2264.jpeg), 14. Domino Blend (IMG_2269.jpeg), 15. Cabin Fever (IMG_2275.jpeg), 16. Feather Gray Blend (IMG_2274.jpeg), 17. Autumn Brown Blend (IMG_2271.jpeg). Remove all Unsplash fallback URLs. Use only the local asset paths.

quotes: All images are in order with the name of colors you provided in the Flake Color Section

acceptanceCriteria: All 17 flake color cards in the FlakeColorsSection display the user-uploaded images instead of any Simiron CDN or Unsplash URLs
Each image is correctly matched to its confirmed color name in the specified order
Images load from frontend/public/assets/generated using local paths only
No external image dependencies (Simiron CDN or Unsplash) remain in FlakeColorsSection
The responsive grid layout and color name labels are preserved exactly as before

constraints: Do not change the FlakeColorsSection layout, grid structure, or any other visual design
Do not modify any backend files
Do not alter the color name labels — they must remain exactly as confirmed by the user
Image order must strictly follow the user-confirmed sequence
nonGoals: Adding new colors or removing existing ones
Any changes to other sections of the site
